import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageTest
/-! DEGREE-ARITHMETIC PROBE (not for landing).

The three numbers that must line up:
  (a) the twisted class has fibre degree  m*d1 - deg Z          (degAt_chartTwist)
  (b) the chart-index constraint is       deg Z = m*d1 - n      (chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup)
  (c) the drop consumes a divisor of degree g + e               (exists_effective_sub_h0_eq_one)

If (b) is taken at n = g the twisted degree is +g, and then (c) forces e = 0 -- i.e. NO drop
budget.  The coverage argument wants e >= 1, so the index must be calibrated at
deg Z = m*d1 - g - e, giving twisted degree g + e.  This probe checks that arithmetic is
consistent rather than trusting the prose. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

-- (a)+(b) at the DROP calibration deg Z = m*d1 - g - e: the twisted fibre degree is g + e.
example (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (g e : ℕ)
    (hcal : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (g : ℤ) - (e : ℤ))
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} (hlam : lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
    degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) t = (g : ℤ) + e := by
  rw [degAt_chartTwist m Z hlam t, hcal]; ring

-- and the class-side degree agrees with the presenting class's degree at that calibration
example (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] (m : ℕ)
    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (g e : ℕ)
    (hcal : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (g : ℤ) - (e : ℤ)) :
    classDeg L (Scheme.CechPic.map ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L)).left)
        (chartTwistClass C m Z)) = (g : ℤ) + e := by
  rw [classDeg_chartTwistClass_baseChange C L m Z, hcal]; ring

-- CONTRAST: at the n = g calibration (no drop budget) the degree is exactly g, so e = 0.
example (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (g : ℕ)
    (hcal : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (g : ℤ))
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} (hlam : lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
    degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) t = (g : ℤ) := by
  rw [degAt_chartTwist m Z hlam t, hcal]; ring

end
end AlgebraicGeometry
EOF
